comment: Shared display contract for menu-name rendering: strip the category prefix (before 全角｜), KEEP the メンズ｜ prefix, never touch trailing durations, apply per ' / '-joined segment. Referenced by BOTH implementations' tests (admin-app/src/lib/service-pricing.test.ts and test/google-calendar-sync.test.ts) so one side cannot drift without the other side's test failing.
